text: Over the last 30 days, several visitors expressed frustration with the library’s timed entry system, particularly the requirement to purchase tickets online well in advance and the lack of walk-up ticket options. Parking was also a common concern, with complaints about narrow lanes, limited camper parking, and poor signage. Some visitors noted issues with crowding and long lines at security, as well as insufficient communication about ticket availability and security procedures in the parking area. Despite these concerns, many reviews mentioned the interactive exhibits and architecture positively, but the operational challenges around access and parking need attention.

Overall, the main areas needing improvement are ticketing access, parking logistics, and visitor communication before and upon arrival.

Parking and traffic flow around the site have also been frequently criticized, with narrow lanes, limited camper parking, and poor signage contributing to a difficult arrival experience. Some visitors noted long lines and inadequate communication about security procedures and ticket availability at the parking lot. While many reviews mention the interactive exhibits and architecture positively, concerns about crowding and limited admission persist. Staff interactions received fewer comments but were generally neutral or positive.
